transform: log for s* and r*, sqrt for dep_frac, log1p for dep_depth
note: Coordinates are LUNAR (latitude, east longitude 0-360); window_m is south polar stereographic metres on a 1,737,400 m sphere (IAU 30135), as in pipeline.io_moon.moon_xy.

polar_160km.name: South pole, 160 x 160 km (default)
polar_160km.coord_source: window centred on the pole (pipeline default; analysis/discovery_test.py)
polar_160km.notes: Tested default reference population: x and y from -80 to +80 km around the pole.

connecting_ridge.name: Connecting Ridge (proposed site)
connecting_ridge.notes: Candidate landing site inside the Artemis 3 'Connecting Ridge' region, not the region centre. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

peak_near_shackleton.name: Peak Near Shackleton (proposed site)
peak_near_shackleton.notes: Candidate landing site inside the Artemis 3 'Peak Near Shackleton' region, not the region centre. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

nobile_rim_2.name: Nobile Rim 2 (top-ranked point)
nobile_rim_2.coord_source: https://arxiv.org/html/2406.19863v2 (Pena-Asensio et al., rank-1 point no. 358, DM2: 84 12'5.61" S, 60 41'59.61" E)
nobile_rim_2.notes: Best of 1,247 evaluated points (multi-criteria ranking), not the region centre. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

malapert_massif.name: Mons Malapert (Malapert Massif)
malapert_massif.notes: IAU feature centre of Mons Malapert. The NASA notional site near the summit (-85.964, 357.681; Kring et al. 2025, doi:10.1029/2024JE008905) could not be opened (HTTP 403) and is about 1.4 km away. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

mons_mouton.name: Mons Mouton
mons_mouton.coord_source: https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/16070 (Mons Mouton, LOLA 2011 network: -84.60, 31.00 E; D = 130 km)
mons_mouton.notes: IAU feature centre of a 130 km massif; the window samples its central part only. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

de_gerlache.name: de Gerlache crater
de_gerlache.coord_source: https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov/Feature/1439 (de Gerlache, primary network: -88.48, -88.34 E; D = 32.71 km)
de_gerlache.notes: IAU crater centre (the research notes had -88.5, 272.9 from an older network: -87.10 E). The 30 km window covers mostly the crater interior and inner walls. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

haworth.name: Haworth crater
haworth.notes: Sources conflict: the gazetteer page lists two other control networks, -87.20 / -7.49 E and -87.45 / -5.17 E (D = 51.42 km), and older lists give -87.4 / 5 W; the primary gazetteer value is used. 30 x 30 km window centred on the site (NASA Artemis candidate regions are about 15 x 15 km but have no published centre coordinates; 30 km gives about 225 cells of 1.92 km).

effres_note: effres: share of the window where LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ_EFFRES exceeds 60 m, sampled every 100 m (nearest neighbour), plus its median; null = could not be read.

base_regions.name: Named candidate regions, pooled (7 x 30 km windows)
base_regions.coord_source: pooled from the member regions below
base_regions.notes: Cells of the seven named regions taken together; own mean and covariance. Default scoring target of pipeline.score / pipeline.sites since job J18 (docs/sources/j18.md).

pooled_note: pooled_regions: reference populations made of the cells of several named regions together (no single window); pipeline.score reads them like regions.
